summary: Live ROCm testing reproduced inert preferred sampling parameters for omitted /v1/chat/completions fields at the prepared baseline and verified that exact candidate fc25fb0ed902605ed7aaf5592a72e42979219965 restores explicit-client > server-preference > model/protocol-default precedence. The deterministic tiny model validates request handling and GPU engine execution, not semantic quality.

tests.what_was_measured: Created deterministic random Llama weights and tokenizer; model.safetensors SHA256 1407483bbc21bd0a4f84eb72acb2eb0d4b23019e5db843029e151f348e8fe108.
All requested HTTP paths executed, but omitted chat output (' five ten nine H user') differed from explicit-preferred output (' A C assistant gamma six F F'), reproducing lost server preferences.

tests.command: candidate server at fc25fb0ed902605ed7aaf5592a72e42979219965 plus probe_sampling_precedence.py --expect-chat-precedence
tests.what_was_measured: Omitted and explicit-preferred chat outputs both equaled ' A C assistant gamma six F F'; explicit override remained distinct; chat/completions streaming ended with [DONE]; the two-prompt completion request returned two choices.

tests.command: transformers AutoModelForCausalLM CPU greedy reference versus live candidate greedy chat request
tests.what_was_measured: Reference token IDs [24,26,3,5,10,26,18,18] decoded to the same token sequence as live output (the API retained one leading space).
48 tests and 25 subtests passed, including the candidate's complete explicit-key precedence regression suite.

gpu_execution.evidence: One visible AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) executed baseline and candidate inference. Server logs show LlamaForCausalLM weight loading, GPU KV-cache allocation, successful prefill/decode batches, and HTTP 200 responses. Attention backend was explicitly torch_native; prefill and decode graph backends resolved to disabled and logs reported cuda graph: False.

remaining_limitations: Tiny random weights establish protocol, precedence, batching, streaming, and ROCm engine execution only; they do not establish semantic model quality.
The candidate is scoped to chat completions. Completion endpoint observations are protocol coverage, not a claim that its omitted-field precedence changed.
Raw run artifacts are retained at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77a1da77d260/artifacts/raw and the generated fixture at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77a1da77d260/models/tiny-llama.
A non-fatal Torch Dynamo metrics logger error (function not JSON serializable) appeared during warmup on both revisions; inference still completed successfully.
